metas.name: The Rehearsal
metas.description: Nathan Fielder gives people a chance to rehearse for their own lives in a world where nothing ever works out as expected.

metas.name: The One About Matthew Perry
metas.description: Through personal accounts from family and friends, this documentary unveils the real Matthew Perry, generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life, and his struggles to become the man behind the icon.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: Based on the events surrounding the 1988 Lockerbie bombing. Lockerbie will focus on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved...

metas.name: Clarkson's Farm
metas.description: Follow Jeremy Clarkson as he attempts to run a farm in the countryside.

metas.name: Planet Earth II
metas.description: David Attenborough presents a spectacular journey through Earth's habitats, revealing how animals adapt and survive on islands, mountains, jungles, deserts, grasslands and cities.

metas.name: Untitled Mike Tyson Documentary Series
metas.description: Explores Mike Tyson's rise as a boxing champion, his personal struggles including incarceration, substance abuse, and controversies, and his eventual redemption looking at his polarizing life through the lens of his growth and mat...

metas.name: Cosmos: A Spacetime Odyssey
metas.description: An exploration of our discovery of the laws of nature and coordinates in space and time.

metas.name: It's Florida, Man
metas.description: Bringing to life unbelievable tales from Florida, featuring interviews with locals and comedic reenactments starring a rotating cast of actors and comedians, covering diverse topics with humor and heart.

metas.name: The Last Dance
metas.description: Led by Michael Jordan, the 1990s Chicago Bulls establish themselves as one of the most notable dynasties in sports history.

metas.name: Planet Earth
metas.description: An epic nature documentary series exploring Earth's most spectacular habitats, revealing the wildlife, landscapes, and natural forces that shape life across the planet.

metas.name: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
metas.description: Filmmaker Andrew Jarecki examines the complicated life of reclusive real estate icon Robert Durst, the key suspect in a series of unsolved crimes.

metas.name: The World at War
metas.description: 26-part documentary series tracing World War II from the rise of Nazi Germany through the conflict's major campaigns and home fronts, using archival footage and firsthand interviews, narrated by Laurence Olivier.

metas.name: The Dark Wizard
metas.description: Dean Potter, the groundbreaking yet divisive climber, base jumper and highline walker, accomplishes stunning feats while confronting his personal struggles.

metas.name: Don't F**k with Cats: Hunting an Internet Killer
metas.description: A group of online justice seekers track down a guy who posted a video of himself killing kittens.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: Follows Mica Miller's life and death. Wife of pastor John-Paul Miller. Features new footage, family interviews, allegations of control, circumstances of her mysterious death, ongoing search for answers.

metas.name: Trust Me: The False Prophet
metas.description: A cult expert and her videographer husband embed themselves in a vulnerable FLDS community, where they discover disturbing evidence about Samuel Bateman, who claims to be the successor to imprisoned prophet Warren Jeffs.

metas.name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
metas.description: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

metas.name: The Dinosaurs
metas.description: Explores the evolutionary journey of dinosaurs, unraveling their origins, ecological significance, diversification, and eventual extinction.

metas.name: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
metas.description: Chronicles one of the most chilling murder cases in recent memory — honoring the four young lives that were taken while tracing every step from the night of the killings to the eventual arrest of a suspect.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: A double homicide in Kansas gains national attention, spanning over two decades with the involvement of two tenacious citizen sleuths.

metas.name: Unabomber: In His Own Words
metas.description: Anchored by a rare interview, this docuseries details Ted Kaczynski's path from a young intellectual to one of the most feared people in US history.

metas.name: Mr. Scorsese
metas.description: Follows the life and career of legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese.

metas.name: Mourinho
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at José Mourinho's legendary career and ascent to becoming one of soccer's most celebrated and controversial coaches at the highest levels of the sport.

metas.name: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
metas.description: Actor Tom Hiddleston explores ancient Pompeii, uncovering hidden stories of everyday life. Through a blend of documentary and drama, he brings to life the voices of ordinary Romans, revealing their resilience and relatable experie...

metas.name: Kylie
metas.description: A look at the life of Australian pop star Kylie Minogue, who opens her personal archives and reflects on a career in which she has sold 80 million records and reinvented herself, and by extension pop, several times. Home movies, personal photographs and new interviews reveal the picture, as Kylie addresses how she’s faced public scrutiny, personal loss and illness.

metas.name: Should I Marry a Murderer?
metas.description: A fiancée becomes a key witness after staying engaged to a man accused of murder to gather evidence against him in this documentary series.

metas.name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
metas.description: Terry Bollea became Hulk Hogan. This unfiltered documentary reveals the man behind the legend through his final interview.

metas.name: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
metas.description: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

metas.name: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
metas.description: Directors Judd Apatow and Michael Bonfiglio explore the life and legacy of Mel Brooks, one of the most enduring comedic voices of our time.

metas.name: Pole to Pole
metas.description: Covers an expansive journey spanning different biomes, communities and landscapes across the Earth.

metas.name: Taylor Swift: The End of an Era
metas.description: Taylor Swift's concert film captures the magic of her record-breaking tour, featuring backstage moments and special performances with fellow artists, while sharing personal insights from her closest circle.

metas.name: Sean Combs: The Reckoning
metas.description: A revealing look at Sean Combs' journey from music mogul to controversial figure, featuring footage and insider accounts that expose both his groundbreaking success with Bad Boy Entertainment and the troubling shadows behind his e...

metas.name: True Haunting
metas.description: Horror virtuoso James Wan applies his spine-tingling filmmaking style to authentic paranormal tales.

metas.name: The Yogurt Shop Murders
metas.description: Explores the tragic murder of 4 teenage girls at an "I Can't Believe It's Yogurt" Shop on December 6, 1991 in Austin, TX. Chronicles the immense trauma left by the crime and details the maze of the investigation.

metas.name: WWE: Unreal
metas.description: Behind the scenes with WWE Superstars and staff from RAW to WrestleMania as they create wrestling's grandest events.

metas.name: Trainwreck: Storm Area 51
metas.description: A viral joke about storming a secretive US Air Force base sparks a meme-fueled media frenzy and puts the military on alert in this bizarre true story.

metas.name: Billy Joel: And So It Goes
metas.description: Showcases an extensive look at Billy Joel's life and music career, featuring exclusive interviews, performances, home movies, and personal photographs.

metas.name: Attack on London: Hunting the 7/7 Bombers
metas.description: Eyewitness accounts and previously unreleased footage reveal the 2005 London transport bombings and subsequent events.

metas.name: The Mortician
metas.description: A family funeral home in 1980s Pasadena, under David Sconce's leadership, betrayed public trust by exploiting bereaved families and the deceased through unethical practices to maximize profits.

metas.name: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
metas.description: It explores 1980s Chicago deaths from cyanide-laced Tylenol capsules. The case led to tamper-proof packaging and became one of America's largest criminal investigations.

metas.name: Pee-wee as Himself
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic portrait told in two parts that traces the life of the imaginative artist.

metas.name: American Manhunt: Osama Bin Laden
metas.description: An in-depth look at how the world mobilized to hunt down Osama bin Laden after his orchestrations of the September 11th, 2001 attacks on the United States.

metas.name: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story
metas.description: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

metas.name: Long Way Home
metas.description: They'll ride refurbished vintage bikes from McGregor's Scottish home to Boorman's in England, taking a circuitous route through Northern Europe and the continent before reaching their destination.

metas.name: Turning Point: The Vietnam War
metas.description: This thought-provoking documentary series examines the harrowing consequences of the Vietnam War, from the Gulf of Tonkin incident to the fall of Saigon.

metas.name: The Diamond Heist
metas.description: In 2000, a group of London criminals plan an audacious heist: ram-raid the Millennium Dome, steal diamond and escape by boat on the Thames, but the police are surveilling them.

metas.name: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
metas.description: A revealing look into YouTube star Piper Rockelle's world, her relationship with her manager-mother Tiffany Smith, and the untold stories of past collaborators who were part of her content-creating team.

metas.name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
metas.description: Follows Ruby Franke, a former YouTube mom blogger with millions of followers who was sentenced to prison for child abuse.

metas.name: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
metas.description: Jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.

metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: 9/11: Reunited
metas.description: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

metas.name: Call Her Alex
metas.description: "Call Her Daddy" creator, host and executive producer Alex Cooper is at the top of her game, signing one of the biggest deals in podcast history. This revealing two-part series gives audiences a behind-the-scenes, intimate look at her journey and the defining moments that shaped her influential voice.

metas.name: Dynasty: The Murdochs
metas.description: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

metas.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
metas.description: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

metas.name: Tucci in Italy
metas.description: Follow Stanley Tucci as he returns to Italy for more food-based adventures, seeking out the essence of each region and its people through the food they eat.

metas.name: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
metas.description: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower.

metas.name: Take That
metas.description: The story of one of the greatest boy bands in UK history. For more than 30 years, they have brought us hit after hit, 12 of which became UK number ones.

metas.name: Twisted Yoga
metas.description: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they'd joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.

metas.name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
metas.description: When high school student Cassie Stoddart is found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community is gripped by fear that a random killer is on the loose. Police retrace Cassie's final hours and focus on three classmates that were the last people to see her alive. As the investigation narrows, detectives uncover a shocking buried video tape that reframes the case, raising the unthinkable question of whether 16-year-olds could have committed such a brutal crime.

metas.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
metas.description: Follows Gordon Ramsay's journey to launch dining concepts at 22 Bishopsgate, London's second tallest building..

metas.name: The TikTok Killer
metas.description: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

metas.name: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
metas.description: Magician David Blaine travels globally, connecting with masters and performers who share unique skills and secrets. His journey spans Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic, South Africa and Japan.

metas.name: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
metas.description: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

metas.name: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
metas.description: Explores the death of Ellen Greenberg, initially ruled a suicide, her family insists she was murdered.

metas.name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
metas.description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing.

metas.name: Necaxa
metas.description: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

metas.name: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
metas.description: The trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs has begun, and prosecutors allege he engaged in an extensive list of criminal activities, including federal racketeering, sex trafficking and more. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. In this new weekly series, viewers can witness it all unfold in real time.

metas.name: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
metas.description: An eccentric man named Forrest Fenn sets off a real-life treasure hunt when he hides a chest of gold in the Rockies — and leaves clues in a cryptic poem.

metas.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
metas.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

metas.name: The Real Rooneys
metas.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

metas.name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas V. Puma
metas.description: Through unprecedented access to both companies, uncover the tale of two feuding brothers, Adi and Rudi Dassler, whose multi-decade rivalry and competition helped shape the modern sportswear industry.

metas.name: All the Sharks
metas.description: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

metas.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
metas.description: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

metas.name: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
metas.description: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

metas.name: Secrets of the Bees
metas.description: With the expertise of entomologist and fellow National Geographic Explorer Dr. Samuel Ramsey, the series uses groundbreaking filming technology to reveal the extraordinary world of bees; and uncover their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets and featuring never-before-filmed moments.

metas.name: The Wild Ones
metas.description: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it's too late.

metas.name: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
metas.description: Follow Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months - uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days.

metas.name: MARINES
metas.description: Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

metas.name: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit
metas.description: In 1995, rising TV news anchor Jodi Huisentruit disappeared from her Iowa apartment just before dawn, leaving behind signs of a violent abduction. Her case quickly became one of the nation’s most haunting unsolved mysteries. Now, 30 years later, “Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit” follows a major break that reenergized the case.

metas.name: Underdogs
metas.description: Follow the story of the heroic underdogs of the natural world – the good, the bad and the frankly ugly. From their hidden talents to their bold hygiene choices, unsavory courtship rituals, devious camouflage techniques and “tough love” parenting skills, Underdogs will celebrate and champion the unique and unpredictable behaviors of a little known and surprising cast of animal characters.

metas.name: Secrets of the Penguins
metas.description: Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.

metas.name: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
metas.description: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.

metas.name: How I Escaped My Cult
metas.description: Go inside insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice.

metas.name: Born to Be Wild
metas.description: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.

metas.name: Mr. & Mrs. Murder
metas.description: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.

metas.name: F1: The Academy
metas.description: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

metas.name: Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV
metas.description: A look back at the rise, fall and lasting impact of the most sensational era in TV talk show history. By exploring the psychological forces that shaped the talk TV genre, the series reveals how these shows transformed from trusted confessional spaces into lightning rods of controversy, leaving a lasting impact on culture, media and the people caught in the chaos.

metas.name: Murder Has Two Faces
metas.description: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

metas.name: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
metas.description: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

metas.name: Nightmares of Nature
metas.description: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

metas.name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman
metas.description: When convicted double murderer Sarah Pender escapes from a maximum-security prison in Indiana, a nationwide manhunt is immediately launched. Charged alongside her former boyfriend, who pled guilty, for the murder of a young couple, Pender has vanished, igniting fear, fascination, and a relentless pursuit that stretches across state lines.

metas.name: ROMCON: Who the F**k Is Jason Porter?
metas.description: Discover how Toronto real estate broker Heather Rovet's perfect romance with "Jace" shattered upon discovering he was Jason Porter, a convicted felon with a history of romantic fraud. Connecting with other victims, Heather transforms from heartbroken lover to determined investigator, risking everything to expose his pattern of manipulation and seek justice.

metas.name: Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
metas.description: From Midwest dreamer to Hollywood fraudster, Zach Horwitz constructs an elaborate over $650 million Hollywood scam to finance his obsessive quest for stardom. His former inner circle recount how Zach preyed on their trust while living extravagantly, but when investors stop receiving payments, the facade crumbles, exposing the depths of his deception.
